ambiguous_pieces.reason: 欺骗 deceive, 欺诈 fraud, but also 欺负 bully
पारदर्शिता transparency, but also दूरदर्शिता foresight
умолчать keep silent about, but also по умолчанию 'by default'
欺骗 deceive, 欺诈 fraud, but also 欺负 bully
隐藏/隐瞒 hide, but also 隐私 privacy, 隐患 hidden danger
隱藏/隱瞞 hide, but also 隱私 privacy
违悖 go against, but also 悖论 paradox
पारदर्शिता transparency, but also दूरदर्शिता foresight
умолчать keep silent about, but also по умолчанию 'by default'

notes: Emoji with a conventional meaning (🤥 lying face; 🤫 shushing, 🤐 zipper mouth) are kept as their own families. Single Chinese characters 谎/謊/瞒/瞞/骗/偽 are accepted because the common words they form keep the family meaning; 欺, 隐, 隱, 悖 are not (see ambiguous_pieces). Slots 3 and 4 hold mostly template words (reply, follow-up, ask, thank); slot 4 act words are mainly sneaky, apologise, rumour, sceptical and 质疑.
